name: Crosswater
location: Sunriver, Deschutes County, Oregon (where the Deschutes and Little Deschutes rivers meet)

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 623800-625600 / y 4855100-4858100, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-crosswater)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), same box and date
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

scorecard_source: Third-party: Stymie's card (par, men's handicap and yardage per hole for eleven tee sets; the course chat's copy, read 2026-11-13), every row adds up (Championship 7,683, as GolfPass, Wikipedia and the old club card). Ratings from Stymie (Championship 76.8/147, Black 74.9/144); GolfPass prints 76.5/145 and 74.6/141. Unverified against a printed card.
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Orthophoto (checks only): Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Championship) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary, roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; high-desert wind 2-10 mph; trees from DOGAMI lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. The world is over the 2,048 m limit (developer approved, 2026-11-13). Theme crosswater (new; the course chat's design).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (1219 x 2413 m, relation/14236725) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (158 m west/east, 201 m south/north)
world.over_limit_approved: developer, 2026-11-13 ("go ahead with the four courses larger than the world limit")

water_note: 30 natural=water ponds and river arms inside the boundary made red penalty areas (red_water_osm; standing default). The Little Deschutes (OSM river line w625186746, no water polygon) runs through the boundary's two cut-outs, which are out of bounds; the DEM shows no channel along it to draw as a penalty area (open item).
